methodology: Universities are retained only when they satisfy both inclusive limits: mandatory numeric overall world rank of 3,200 or better and non-EU tuition of €5,000 or less per semester. EduRank 2026 is preferred; when EduRank has no institutional record, the row note identifies the fallback provider and edition. Subject ranks are included only for directly matching published topics and are never inferred; an em dash means no reliable matching value was identified. Rankings from different providers use different methodologies and should not be treated as perfectly comparable. Every row has numeric non-EU tuition per semester: €0 means official programme tuition is absent, while monthly or total private fees are normalised to a semester and explained in the row. Semester contributions and application fees remain separate. Programme suitability is evaluated for an international CSE graduate with software-engineering experience, without asserting eligibility. Every row has exactly one ownership chip: blue Public or violet Private. Green open chips mean the official route was accepting applications for the named intake on 22 July 2026; teal Summer ’27 and amber Winter ’27 confirm an intake but not a currently open window; red No CS intake ’27 marks no suitable shortlisted intake. Exact application timing remains in the application-window text. Official programme links are the final admissions authority.
caveats: Ranks are ordinal bibliometric positions, not quality scores; do not average them or treat a fixed rank gap as a fixed quality gap.

The inclusion rules are conjunctive and inclusive: overall rank must be 3,200 or better and non-EU tuition must be €5,000 or less per semester. Failing either rule excludes the institution even when it has a qualifying programme or open application route.
A suitable programme means strongly related to CS or engineering and plausibly relevant to Tanima's background, not guaranteed admission.

Tuition and semester contributions are separate. Every row has a numeric tuition amount; a visible €0 means no programme tuition was identified under the current policy, while semester contributions, application fees and normal living/visa funding still apply.

Application shows the first standalone application cost. uni-assist charges €75 for the first course and €30 for each additional course in the same semester; route reuse and later fee changes can alter the applicant's final total.
EduRank is an independent bibliometric ranking provider, not a German government or university authority.

Overall rank is mandatory: EduRank 2026 is used where available and each fallback is named in the row note. Subject values remain blank rather than being inferred. EduRank lists TH Köln as Cologne University of Applied Sciences.
Where a future intake window was not confirmed, the row explicitly says to verify the next published dates instead of projecting an old deadline.

Plain Summer ’27 or Winter ’27 chips identify a relevant intake, not an open-for-applications guarantee. A green chip ending in open reflects the official route on 22 July 2026, but capacity and visa feasibility can change. Public and Private are separate ownership badges. Recheck the row's application window and official portal before applying.
LMU Data Science is marked discontinued and Charité is marked unsuitable so neither is recommended from rank alone.
